xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5477: docs: permission modes and agent guardrails

plan.title: docs: permission modes and agent guardrails
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Overdeck has no user page about permissions. Facts are scattered across reference/settings.mdx, configuration/mcp.mdx, configuration/auto-merge.mdx and cli/conversation-commands.mdx. Planning also found that the Settings Auto description and pan --help say Auto blocks destructive commands, while the auto-approve hook approves every tool call except AskUserQuestion for sessions Overdeck launches (filed as #5566).
narratives.Proposal: Add configuration/permissions.mdx with sections on Claude Code permission modes, the --yolo/PAN_YOLO override, Codex modes, answering permission prompts from the dashboard, operator-only labels, the agent git shim, primary checkout refusals, other guardrails and getting help, every fact taken from code per PRD facts F-1 to F-36. Document what the code does and link #5566 once where UI and help text disagree. Add the page to docs.json after configuration/harnesses, change one link or add one sentence in four related pages, and validate with mint@4.3.49 and lint:docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code change: the Settings Auto and Codex descriptions, the pan --help --yolo text, tests/fixtures/pan-help.txt, the settings-api.ts comment, docs/CONFIGURATION.md and the project .pan.yaml permission override are fixed in #5566
- No claim that Auto blocks, filters or classifies destructive commands, and no mention of --dangerously-skip-permissions
- No code change for the Codex app-server permission mode (#5567); the page describes today's behavior and links it
- No mention of the answer_agent_permission MCP tool (it serves the excluded legacy Channels relay)
- No screenshots and no change to images/
- No HTTP route reference, no legacy Channels Tool Permission Required dialog, no IS_SANDBOX, no per-project .pan.yaml override, no pan shutdown deny, no Deft permission rules
- No claim about whether pan reload or pan restart keeps a --yolo override
- No sentence changes in the four linking pages beyond one added sentence or the one Settings row link
- No changelog.d entry

autoDecisions.summary: One new page configuration/permissions.mdx placed right after configuration/harnesses in the Configuration group
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names configuration/permissions.mdx, and permission modes are configured per harness.

autoDecisions.summary: Where code and the Settings or --help text disagree, document the code and link the filed bug #5566 once
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires every claim to match current code; the same pattern was used for #5562 in the merged costs page (PAN-5475).

autoDecisions.summary: Describe the git and gh shims and deny rules as accident prevention, not a sandbox
autoDecisions.rationale: launcher-git-guard.ts and claude-settings-overlay.ts state this themselves; readers must not over-trust them.

autoDecisions.summary: Repoint the reference/settings.mdx Permissions row link from Harnesses to the new page; other linking pages get one added sentence
autoDecisions.rationale: The new page is the dedicated page for that Settings section; one-change edits avoid conflicts with sibling docs issues.

autoDecisions.summary: Cover Codex modes and pan task claim guardrails alongside the issue-listed topics
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex shares the Settings Permissions section, and #4357 (task claim) is in the v0.64.0 changelog entry the issue lists.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave out the legacy Channels permission dialog and the per-project .pan.yaml override
autoDecisions.rationale: Channels is an opt-in legacy transport; the .pan.yaml override depends on the launching process cwd and is under review in #5566.
